verdicts_or_reports.screen: Shop > Sell > Sell Old Gear sheet and per-item sell panel
verdicts_or_reports.element: Iron Sword row (Sell Old Gear sheet) and Sell: Iron Sword quantity control
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With "Keep one of each item" OFF, all unequipped copies are offered: Iron Sword ×3 (186 coins) and Bronze Axe ×2 (50 coins) in Sell Old Gear; the per-item panel's Max is 3. Only the toggle ON should reserve one copy.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With the toggle OFF, Sell Old Gear lists "Iron Sword ×2 124" and "Bronze Axe ×1 25", total 5,416. The per-item panel for Iron Sword opens at 2 with Max and + disabled, and Bronze Axe offers no quantity control (max 1). The same rows appear with the toggle ON, so the toggle makes no difference to multi-copy gear. Sell Junk does honour the toggle (Cowhide ×14 → ×13 when ON).
steps: Open Shop, tap Sell tab. Confirm Keep one of each item is OFF.
Inventory has Iron Sword ×3 in inventory (plus one equipped) and Bronze Axe ×2 in inventory (plus one equipped).
Tap Sell Old Gear. Observe Iron Sword ×2 (124) and Bronze Axe ×1 (25), Total 5,416.
Tap the Iron Sword row. The sell panel opens at quantity 2; Increase and Max are disabled.
Turn Keep one of each item ON. Tap Sell Old Gear again: the same Iron Sword ×2 and Bronze Axe ×1 rows appear, total 149 only if the gear list is filtered, with no change from OFF for these two items.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The Bosses tab counts only bosses, so its total matches the number of boss entries listed (about 7-8 here), e.g. "0 / 8 encountered".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After switching from Enemies to Bosses, the header still reads "0 / 100 encountered" (0%), the same total as the Enemies tab, while the Bosses list shows only about 8 entries (Brood Empress, Demon Lord, Gothic Ember, King Black Dragon, Kraken, Obsidian Colossus, Sol Invictus...).
steps: Open Profile, tap Bestiary.
Note the Enemies tab header: "0 / 100 encountered", 0%.
Tap the Bosses tab.
Observe the header still reads "0 / 100 encountered" and 0%, while the list shows about 8 bosses.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Bronze Boots row shows "×1 in inventory" (Profile > Inventory lists Bronze Boots ×1 besides the equipped copy), like the other equipped rows (Bronze Axe ×2, Bronze Pickaxe ×1, Iron Sword ×3 in inventory).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In the Sell tab Armor section, the Bronze Boots row reads "(equipped)" and "10 coins ea." with no inventory count. Earlier in the same session the row read "Bronze Boots | (equipped) | ×1 in inventory | 10 coins ea.", and the Profile > Inventory screen lists Bronze Boots ×1.
steps: Open Home > Shop, then the Sell tab.
Look at the Armor section: Bronze Boots shows "(equipped)" and "10 coins ea." with no "×1 in inventory".
Open Profile > Inventory > Armour: Bronze Boots ×1 is listed.
Note: after a Sell Junk sale the same row briefly showed "×1 in inventory"; the count then disappeared again on re-entering the Sell tab.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Shop > Buy > Buy: Logs quantity panel
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Max is the most Logs the coins can buy: floor(2,567,890 / 7) = 366,841 (cost 2,567,887). Buy must not offer a total above the coins held.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Pressing Max fills the quantity with 366919, and the panel shows "Total cost 2.5M coins". 366,919 × 7 = 2,568,433, which is 543 coins more than the 2,567,890 held. The Buy button stays enabled.
steps: Starting data: 2,567,890 coins (shown as 2.5M), Logs cost 7 coins each.
Shop > Buy tab. Tap the Logs row (7 coins each).
In the Buy: Logs panel, tap Max.
Observe quantity 366919 and Total cost 2.5M coins. 366,919 × 7 = 2,568,433 > 2,567,890 held.
Do not tap Buy (cancelled to avoid driving coins negative).

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Shop > Sell > Sell Old Gear sheet and per-item sell panel (Keep one of each item OFF)
verdicts_or_reports.field: sellable quantity of a single spare copy
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Two items with the same inventory count (×1) and the same toggle state (OFF) should offer the same sellable quantity. Bronze Dagger ×1 (not equipped) is offered: 1 sellable, 25 coins. Iron Sword ×1 in inventory (equipped copy also owned) should be offered the same way, 1 sellable, 62 coins, and appear in Sell Old Gear.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With the toggle OFF, Sell Old Gear lists Bronze Dagger ×1 (25) but omits Iron Sword (its only inventory copy is ×1 "in inventory", plus an equipped copy). The Iron Sword row still shows "×1 in inventory" and "62 coins ea.". The total is 5,267 with nine rows; Iron Sword contributes nothing. Earlier, Iron Sword ×3 and ×2 were also reduced by one, so the spare is held back regardless of the toggle.
verdicts_or_reports.observed_quote: Iron Sword | (equipped) | ×1 in inventory | 62 coins ea.
steps: Starting data: Iron Sword equipped; inventory Iron Sword ×1 after earlier sales. Keep one of each item is OFF.
Shop > Sell. Confirm Bronze Dagger shows "×1 in inventory" and Iron Sword shows "(equipped)" and "×1 in inventory".
Tap Bronze Dagger row: panel "Sell: Bronze Dagger" offers 1 (25 coins).
Tap Sell Old Gear: list has nine rows including Bronze Dagger ×1 (25); Iron Sword is absent. Total 5,267.
Tap the Iron Sword row: no quantity control is offered (0 sellable).
